# fcl-css (Free Component Library - CSS)

- **Source:** Free Pascal upstream (`packages/fcl-css`)
- **Author:** Michael Van Canneyt <michael@freepascal.org>
- **License:** GNU LGPL v2 with FPC linking exception (Modified LGPL)
- **Included Units:**
  - `fpcssscanner.pp`: Tokenizer
  - `fpcsstree.pp`: Abstract Syntax Tree (AST)
  - `fpcssparser.pp`: CSS parser
  - `fpcssresparser.pas`: Value & shorthand parser
  - `fpcssresolver.pas`: Specificity, cascade & selector resolver (`ICSSNode`)
  - `fpcssutils.pp`: Helper utilities
